build_anynet_model: build an AnyNet model from a config dict with depths, widths, strides, and block type
create_anynetparams: create an AnyNetParams object to configure depths, widths, group widths, and bottleneck multipliers for stages
build_resbottleneckblock: build a ResBottleneckBlock with configurable group width, bottleneck multiplier, and squeeze-and-excitation ratio
create_anystage: create an AnyStage with a sequence of blocks sharing the same output shape and depth
review_anynet_forward: review the AnyNet forward pass that applies the stem then trunk_output to input tensor x
